name: Waveshare RP2350-Zero
description: The RP2350 version of the Zero: 23.5 x 18 mm, USB-C, 2 MB flash, WS2812 LED and 20 castellated GPIOs (29 with pads) for under $5; dual Cortex-M33 / Hazard3 in a tiny board.
notes: RP2350A (30 GPIOs): GP0-15 and GP26-29 on the castellated edge, GP17-GP25 on underside pads, GP16 drives the WS2812 LED.
BOOT and RUN buttons give UF2 programming. No SWD header.
Sold without headers ($4.79); pre-soldered version about $1 more. Same footprint and pin order as the RP2040-Zero.
